spans.text: What?!
...Alright, you got me good, Griffin Commander.
What should we do now, Captain?
Beep beep — an encrypted message comes through.
The corner of Yegor's mouth faintly turns up.
I have to admit, you have your tricks. But in cards, the winner takes all, and I'll be the one drawing the joker in the end.
Pull our frontal troops back to a safe distance.
Quartz, I have news for you.
...In the train command room.
(Coughs)... Commander, are you alright...
I think all my limbs are still attached and intact... What about Dandelion?
I'm fine.
Looks like luck was on our side...
Dandelion, have the Dolls move into the quarantine wall.
After that, plant explosives in the train's chassis. I'm going to make this train a complete roadblock.
It seems you are fully determined to not leave this place.
If we complete our mission, we'll have all the time to leave...
Looks like those guys outside are still eyeing us.
If the AR Team can take the shore guns, we'll have a chance to crush the Military's forces.
After that, we can take care of the problems within the base.
Elsewhere... Five minutes ago.
The AR Team is currently headed toward the coastline.
How much further till we're there?
At our current speed, it should take about two more minutes!
Careful! The Typhon's shooting at us again!
My grenades aren't getting through at all! How the hell are they so accurate from so far away?!
Fire off all your grenades at the very least!
Who knows, if we lighten the load, we might go faster!
Hey, is it really alright to take this path?
This is a big flat plain with no cover at all! These wind turbines are all we have to protect us from enemy fire!
There's no time, they've got a vehicle on our tail!
Careful, careful! Those fan blades nearly took my head off!
Get down from the roof!
It's too dangerous up there!
Floor it!
Once we get to the bunkers, their anti-armor guns won't be able to get us!
Got it!
Look, to the right!
It's another Typhon.
They must really want the coastal defense artillery. RO, we have to speed up!
Arghhhhhhh I don't care anymore! Hang on tight!
If you get thrown off, it's your problem!
The AR Team's Jeep rushes at top speed toward the bunker complex at the base of the shore guns.
It evades shot after shot from the Typhons, while SOP launches one grenade after another at the fast-approaching Military vehicles, forcing them to slow down.
The Jeep finally reaches the bunkers ahead of the Military and screeches to a halt, and several Dolls quickly jump off it.

The Military vehicles, which have been swerving to avoid SOP-II's grenades also stop at the other entrance. The soldiers who disembark exchange glances with the Dolls in the distance. Both sides pause for a moment before dashing into the bunkers without any hesitation.
Dammit! We need to get there ahead of them!
Once you're in, keep the other troops from entering. I'll go seize the control center.
Dandelion! Plot me a course! Find the soldiers who are already inside!
Position verified.
The opposition isn't too numerous, and now that they've split up, Dolls have the advantage in confined spaces!
SOP-II, RO, hold the entrance. AR-15, clear the lower levels.
You must not let more Military personnel in!
With that, M4 charges into the bunker as well.
Alright! I've been wanting to thump them for a long time!
I've always envied that inexhaustible confidence of yours...
We only stand a chance because of that confidence.
I know that. No matter what, we can't let our team leader down, right?
Of course. I'm going in. Hold the fort.
Understood.
